newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Tele-Network gets Guyana rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Tele-Network gets Guyana rate hike.

text.p: Atlantic Tele-Network Inc said on Wednesday Guyana's High Court has invalidated orders issued in 1995 by the Guyana Public Utilities Commission requiring its Guyana Telephone & Telegraph Co Ltd to roll back rates by 10 percent for outbound, international calls from Guyana.
Also voided was an order requiring Atlantic's Guyana unit to offer a 50 percent discount on all calls made during off-peak hours, on weekends or on holidays.

Earlier Wednesday, Atlantic Tele-Network said it would split off its Virgin Islands operations into a separate company. The Guyana unit would remain with Atlantic Tele-Network, and comprise its principal asset.
